rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Five Stars of Online Research Articles Ontology (FiveStars)
rdf:Description.dc:creator: David Shotton (https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5506-523X)
rdf:Description.dc:title: The Five Stars of Online Research Articles Ontology (FiveStars)
rdf:Description.dcterms:bibliographicCitation: Shotton, D. (2012). The Five Stars of Online Journal Articles - a Framework for Article Evaluation. In D-Lib Magazine, 18 (1/2). https://doi.org/10.1045/january2012-shotton (Open Access)
rdf:Description.vann:changes: * **v1.1.0**: added new documentation, including annotation properties (e.g., `bibo:doi`, `schema:codeRepository`, etc.), term properties (e.g., `vann:example`, `vs:term_status`, etc.), exemplary competency questions with their respective SPARQL queries, and a Grafoo diagram.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has machine-readable metadata rating
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Integer rating (from 0 to 4) given to journal artice for machine-readable metadata.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has open access rating
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Integer rating (from 0 to 4) given to journal artice for open access.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: open access rating comment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A comment explaining Five Stars ratings given to journal artice relating to open access.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has enhanced content rating
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Integer rating (from 0 to 4) given to journal artice for enhanced content.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: enhanced content rating comment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A comment explaining Five Stars ratings given to journal artice relating to enhanced content.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has peer review rating
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Integer rating (from 0 to 4) given to journal artice for peer review.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: available datasets rating comment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A comment explaining Five Stars ratings given to journal artice relating to available datasets.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: peer review rating comment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A comment explaining Five Stars ratings given to journal artice relating to peer review.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: machine-readable metadata rating comment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A comment explaining Five Stars ratings given to journal artice relating to machine-readable metadata.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: overall five stars rating comment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A comment on overall Five Stars rating given to journal artice.
rdf:Description.vann:example: :my-article fivestars:hasOverallFiveStarsRating "9"^^xsd:nonNegativeInteger ; fivestars:overallFiveStarsRatingComment "The nature of this article, being a position paper rather than a research paper with primary research data, has influenced the overall rating obtained." .

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has overall five stars rating
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Overall Five stars rating (on integer scale from from 0 to 20) given to journal artice, obtained by summing the individual ratings given for each of the Five Stars of Online Journal Articles.
rdf:Description.vann:example: :my-article fivestars:hasOverallFiveStarsRating "9"^^xsd:nonNegativeInteger ; fivestars:overallFiveStarsRatingComment "The nature of this article, being a position paper rather than a research paper with primary research data, has influenced the overall rating obtained." .

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has available datasets rating
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Integer rating (from 0 to 4) given to journal artice for available datasets.
